answer: A datacenter or proxy pool as a result cannot mint a fleet in one epoch whatever the capital it holds, as each identity consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. The comet cap is enforced at intake and walnut reveals the per-origin counts. At most 2 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a saffron tag. That is 28 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
